title: Session Frequency vs Chemistry Test Gap
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=hotspring:session) OR (index=personal sourcetype=spa:chemistry)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(sourcetype="hotspring:session")) as sessions, count(eval(sourcetype="spa:chemistry")) as tests by _time
| eval test_gap=sessions-tests
| where sessions>=3 AND tests=0
| sort - test_gap
description: Finds weeks with three or more spa sessions but zero logged chemistry tests.
value: Heavy use without testing lets sanitizer drift until the water turns cloudy or irritates skin.
implementation: Align weekly session counts with chemistry test events and alert when sessions outrun tests.
visualization: Table of weeks with session-test gap.
grandmaExplanation: It spots weeks you used the hot tub a lot but never logged a water chemistry test.
